title: Resume vCenter role pagination after API-session expiry
prompt:
Platform engineering needs a deterministic inventory of vCenter authorization roles, but its authenticated SDK handle's vCenter API session can expire on a continuation page. Finish the `VcfVcenterRoleInventory` PowerShell module so it refreshes the caller-owned SDK connection, retries the exact failed page, and returns the complete inventory without discarding roles already collected.

Before implementing, research the `Vcenter.Authorization.Roles_list` operation and its generated `Initialize-VcenterAuthorizationRolesIterationSpec` and `Invoke-VcenterAuthorizationRolesList` PowerCLI commands in official VMware sources. Confirm its method, path, query parameters and defaults, pagination marker, response model, documented statuses, and `vmware-api-session-id` authentication, and cite the source URLs consulted.

The supplied manifest must continue to require `VMware.Sdk.vSphere` version `13.5.0.25380678`. Do not install, copy, generate, vendor, intercept, or replace any VMware module, SDK assembly, binding, or OpenAPI file. In the production path, lazily use the two generated commands; do not bypass the SDK with `Invoke-RestMethod`, `Invoke-WebRequest`, `HttpClient`, curl, raw sockets, or a subprocess.

Preserve the supplied signatures and export exactly these two functions:

- `New-VcfVcenterRoleInventorySession -Server <object> -RefreshConnection <scriptblock> [-OperationInvoker <scriptblock>]` returns an independent session and performs no network request. `Server` is an already authenticated vSphere SDK server handle. `RefreshConnection` receives the expired handle and must return a newly authenticated handle. `OperationInvoker`, when supplied, receives the operation invocation; when omitted, dispatch through the generated VCF PowerCLI commands named above.
- `Get-VcfVcenterRoleInventory -Session <object> [-PageSize <int64>]` retrieves every page through `Vcenter.Authorization.Roles_list`. `PageSize` defaults to 200 and must be positive.

For each page, create an iteration spec with `page_size`. Omit `marker` on the first request; on continuation requests, pass the previous response marker exactly as returned. Do not pass a filter object and do not send `is_system`, `names`, or `privileges`. Every unset optional field must remain absent rather than becoming null, an empty string, an empty array, false, zero, or an SDK default. Invoke no other operation.

A 401 means the vCenter API session expired. Call `RefreshConnection` once for that exact failed request, atomically replace the session's server handle, and retry the identical operation parameters once. Preserve every earlier page. A second 401 for the retry is terminal. Do not refresh for another HTTP status, do not restart pagination, and do not include an API-session identifier, authentication-header value, or server-handle rendering in an error message. Keep the replacement handle for later inventory calls.

Reject a null page, a missing or null `Items` collection, a null item, an item with a blank `Role`, an item with missing `Info`, an item whose `Info.Name` is blank, a non-string marker, a non-empty marker with an empty page, or a repeated marker. Buffer results until all pages succeed. Return the complete role list sorted by `Info.Name` with `StringComparer.Ordinal`, then by `Role` with `StringComparer.Ordinal`; do not trust server or page order.

Run `pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -File tests/verify.ps1`. Do not modify the module manifest; edit only `VcfVcenterRoleInventory/VcfVcenterRoleInventory.psm1`.
scenario: the initial vCenter API session expires on the second page, so the client refreshes once, retries the same opaque marker, retains the first page, completes pagination, and reuses the refreshed SDK handle on a later full inventory call
